title: Yellow Roasted Brazilian Chicken Spring Rolls
description: A kid-friendly Brazilian dish featuring roasted chicken and egg rolls, perfect for a fun and tasty meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and turmeric.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Allow the chicken to cool, then chop into small pieces.
Lay an egg roll wrapper on a flat surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the chopped chicken in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a small amount of water, then fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and chicken.
Serve the spring rolls hot and enjoy.
